messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: Tenant-scoped quality regression for tenant 'omni-enterprises' (acct-4532) on dedicated pool dedicated-us-west-2-pool-11. Signal: user-quality-reports + abnormal low-confidence token rate. Affected model: opt-6q-3b-quant-v2 with qprofile override qprofile-v19. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/quality/tenant-4532
Nina Patel: Pinging oncall for dedicated. @Ryan Park you're up. This looks customer-impacting, low confidence answers and elevated NPS tickets.
Ryan Park: oncall ack — taking it. Assigning initial triage.
Jonas Li: joining. Any correlation to deploys or config changes?
Sara Kim: Ops note: we rolled quant profile v19 to several tenants during last night's rollout. Most tenants stable; omni-enterprises is the only one showing large regression in our canary metrics.
Eli Warren: quick ML check: offline eval on their prompt set shows a 10% drop in exact-match-type scoring and a rise in rare-token entropy. Suspect quantization edge-case for their prompt distribution.
Ryan Park: mitigation strategy proposal: 1) immediate traffic routing to local fallback model within the same pool (opt-6q-3b-quant-v2-fallback) to remove customer pain; 2) revert tenant override from qprofile-v19 -> qprofile-v17; 3) restart tenant slice; 4) monitor for 30m; 5) escalate to ML for deeper root cause if regression persists.
Maya Torres: CS notified and drafting customer update. We'll do a short note now and a follow-up when stabilized. Ticket CRD-9876 created.
Jonas Li: applying routing change. Command: 
```
redwoodctl route set --tenant omni-enterprises --pool dedicated-us-west-2-pool-11 --model opt-6q-3b-quant-v2-fallback --weight 100
```
Jonas Li: route change applied. Verified: 
```
2026-06-01T09:48:12Z route-change tenant=acct-4532 -> opt-6q-3b-quant-v2-fallback status=OK
```
Ryan Park: good. Proceed to tenant-config revert. Use tenant-only scope to avoid global impacts.
Eli Warren: running tenant config rollback: 
```
redwoodctl tenant-config update --tenant omni-enterprises --key quant_profile --value qprofile-v17 --scope tenant
```
Eli Warren: revert applied. Initiating slice restart to pick up runtime config. 
```
redwoodctl pool restart-slice --pool dedicated-us-west-2-pool-11 --tenant omni-enterprises
```
Nina Patel: restart started. Watching logs for new inference worker init.
Jonas Li: restart completed. Logs show workers booted with qprofile-v17. Sampling a few requests returned improved confidence scores.
Eli Warren: quick smoke eval after restart: improvement seen. Low-confidence-rate back near baseline. Metrics: low-conf delta now +0.8% vs baseline (acceptable). Latency unchanged.
Maya Torres: customer message sent: "We've routed you to a fallback model and reverted your quantization override. We're monitoring closely and will update in 30 minutes." They replied: "We can confirm responses look better. Thanks."
Ryan Park: marking incident P0 until stable for 60m. Oncall checklist: monitor SLOs, customer ticket, and any cross-tenant anomalies.
Jonas Li: starting a 5% canary of the revert across small traffic subset to ensure no hidden side-effects.
Sara Kim: Ops note: this is tenant-scoped impact due to qprofile-v19 mismatch. Recommend ML add tenant-specific evals to rollout gating and avoid aggressive quant profiles on enterprise VPCs by default.
Eli Warren: opened follow-up PR and issue: quant-profiles: add tenant evals + blocklist enterprise VPCs for qprofile-v19. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/quant-profiles/pull/421; Issue: QP-1123.
Ryan Park: handoff: I'll monitor for another 30m then hand to Nina for overlap. If anything flares, page paging-policy-1.
Nina Patel: I'll take over after Ryan. Planning to run the 1h stability window and capture metrics snapshots at +15m, +30m, +60m.
Maya Torres: CS will prepare a concise post-incident note for the customer and offer a follow-up engineering sync.
Jonas Li: ops reminder: update runbooks to highlight tenant vs global quant-profile changes and include the explicit rollback commands we used.
Sara Kim: security check — no data-plane changes, only runtime config; no exfil risk.
incident-bot: Annotated incident: severity=P0, customer=omni-enterprises, pool=dedicated-us-west-2-pool-11, model=opt-6q-3b-quant-v2, mitigation=route-to-fallback+tenant-quant-revert, ticket=CRD-9876.
Ryan Park: postmortem owner assigned. I'll draft initial timeline and root-cause hypotheses. Will link CRD-9876 and PR/QP-1123. Keeping thread open until postmortem posted. :white_check_mark:
Nina Patel: confirmed stability at +45m. Metrics steady. I'll close the monitoring window at +60m unless new alerts appear.
Maya Torres: final customer update sent at 10:54 UTC. They acknowledged and asked for postmortem when available.
Eli Warren: ML action items created and owners assigned.
Jonas Li: closing ops notes: ensure future quant rollouts include tenant-slice smoke tests for enterprise pools.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Transitioning to post-incident review phase.
